boundary: Loose supply: IEC supplies HP, IP and LP bypass valves with desuperheaters (free issue to site); EPC installs them in its piping, supplies the spray water lines from the BFP discharge/interstage and CEP discharge and all welds.
connection: butt-weld ends; spray water flanges CL2500 (HP) / CL600 (IP, LP)
contractor_side: IEC: valves supplied loose by IEC (incl. desuperheating)
isolation: EPC isolation on the spray water lines; bypass valves close on loss of spray water (IEC logic).
location_text: valves supplied loose by IEC (incl. desuperheating)
operating_conditions: Inlet side most onerous (HP bypass inlet); delivery of the loose valves by 2028-02-01 for piping erection.
owner_side: EPC: installation in EPC piping, spray water from BFP/CEP (EPC)
protection: HP bypass downstream design 52 bar(a) (CRH); IP/LP bypass downstream 16 bar(a) (IF-14).
size: HP 12 in / IP 28 in / LP 20 in (per valve datasheets)
